SELECT t.id, t.stocktake_no, t.warehouse_id, t.stocktake_type, t.blind_flag, t.freeze_flag, t.total_item, t.done_item, t.status, t.initiator_id, t.audit_by, t.audit_at, t.adjusted_at, t.create_time
ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}

SELECT t.id, t.stocktake_no, t.warehouse_id, t.stocktake_type, t.blind_flag, t.freeze_flag, t.total_item, t.done_item, t.status, t.initiator_id, t.audit_by, t.audit_at, t.adjusted_at, t.create_time FROM ph_inv_stocktake t WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND t.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND t.deleted = b'0'

SELECT l.id, l.stocktake_id, l.batch_id, l.location_id, l.drug_id, b.batch_no, l.book_qty, l.real_qty, l.diff_qty, l.diff_flag, l.scanned_flag FROM ph_inv_stocktake_line l JOIN ph_inv_stocktake t ON t.id = l.stocktake_id AND t.tenant_id = l.tenant_id JOIN ph_inv_batch b ON b.id = l.batch_id AND b.tenant_id = l.tenant_id WHERE l.stocktake_id = #{id} AND l.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND t.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND l.deleted = b'0' AND t.deleted = b'0' ORDER BY l.id

SELECT id, stocktake_no, warehouse_id, status, blind_flag, freeze_flag, store_id FROM ph_inv_stocktake WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ph_inv_stocktake_line WHERE stocktake_id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ph_inv_stocktake_line WHERE stocktake_id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0' AND real_qty IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ph_inv_stocktake (tenant_id, store_id, stocktake_no, warehouse_id, stocktake_type, blind_flag, freeze_flag, scope, total_item, done_item, status, initiator_id, creator, updater) VALUES (#{scope.tenantId}, #{scope.storeId}, #{stocktakeNo}, #{q.warehouseId}, #{q.stocktakeType}, #{q.blindFlag}, #{q.freezeFlag}, #{q.scope}, 0, 0, 0, #{operator}, #{operator}, #{operator})

INSERT INTO ph_inv_stocktake_line (tenant_id, stocktake_id, batch_id, drug_id, book_qty, real_qty, diff_qty, diff_flag, scanned_flag, creator, updater, location_id) SELECT s.tenant_id, #{stocktakeId}, s.batch_id, s.drug_id, s.qty, NULL, 0, 0, 0, #{operator}, #{operator}, s.location_id FROM ph_inv_location_stock s JOIN ph_inv_batch b ON b.id = s.batch_id AND b.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND b.drug_id = s.drug_id JOIN ph_location l ON l.id = s.location_id AND l.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND l.warehouse_id = b.warehouse_id WHERE s.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND b.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND b.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND s.deleted = b'0' AND b.deleted = b'0' AND l.deleted = b'0'
mapper.update: UPDATE ph_inv_stocktake t SET total_item = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ph_inv_stocktake_line l WHERE l.stocktake_id = t.id AND l.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND l.deleted = b'0'), updater = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND t.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND t.deleted = b'0'

UPDATE ph_inv_stocktake_line SET real_qty = #{realQty}, diff_qty = #{diffQty}, diff_flag = #{diffFlag}, scanned_flag = 1, updater = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{lineId} AND stocktake_id = #{stocktakeId} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0'

UPDATE ph_inv_stocktake t SET done_item = #{done}, updater = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND t.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND t.deleted = b'0'
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.stocktake_id, l.batch_id, l.location_id, l.drug_id, b.batch_no, l.book_qty, l.real_qty, l.diff_qty, l.diff_flag, b.expiry_date, b.cost_price, b.warehouse_id FROM ph_inv_stocktake_line l JOIN ph_inv_stocktake t ON t.id = l.stocktake_id AND t.tenant_id = l.tenant_id JOIN ph_inv_batch b ON b.id = l.batch_id AND b.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND b.store_id = t.store_id WHERE l.stocktake_id = #{id} AND l.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND t.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND l.deleted = b'0' AND t.deleted = b'0' ORDER BY b.warehouse_id, l.batch_id, l.location_id, l.id

SELECT id, warehouse_id, store_id, drug_id, qty_total, qty_avail, qty_frozen, version, cost_price FROM ph_inv_batch WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.id, s.batch_id, s.location_id, s.drug_id, s.qty, s.qty_frozen FROM ph_inv_location_stock s JOIN ph_inv_batch b ON b.id = s.batch_id AND b.tenant_id = s.tenant_id JOIN ph_location l ON l.id = s.location_id AND l.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND l.warehouse_id = b.warehouse_id WHERE s.batch_id = #{batchId} AND s.location_id = #{locationId} AND s.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND b.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND s.deleted = b'0' AND b.deleted = b'0' AND l.deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT l.id, l.status, l.max_capacity, COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) AS used_qty FROM ph_location l JOIN ph_warehouse w ON w.id = l.warehouse_id AND w.tenant_id = l.tenant_id LEFT JOIN ph_inv_location_stock s ON s.location_id = l.id AND s.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND s.deleted = b'0' WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND l.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND w.store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND l.deleted = b'0' AND w.deleted = b'0' GROUP BY l.id, l.status, l.max_capacity FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ph_inv_batch SET qty_total = qty_total + #{delta}, qty_avail = qty_avail + #{delta}, version = version + 1, updater = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND store_id = #{scope.storeId} AND deleted = b'0'
UPDATE ph_inv_location_stock SET qty = qty + #{delta}, updater = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ph_inv_location_stock (tenant_id, batch_id, location_id, drug_id, qty, qty_frozen, creator, updater) VALUES (#{scope.tenantId}, #{line.batchId}, #{line.locationId}, #{line.drugId}, #{line.diffQty}, 0, #{operator}, #{operator})

INSERT INTO ph_inv_flow (tenant_id, store_id, batch_id, drug_id, batch_no, flow_type, in_qty, out_qty, balance_qty, biz_type, biz_no, flow_time, operator, creator, updater, location_id, biz_line_id, frozen_delta, unit_cost) SELECT #{scope.tenantId}, #{scope.storeId}, #{line.batchId}, #{line.drugId}, #{line.batchNo}, 40, CASE WHEN #{line.diffQty} > 0 THEN #{line.diffQty} ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN #{line.diffQty} < 0 THEN -#{line.diffQty} ELSE 0 END, #{balance}, 4, t.stocktake_no, #{flowTime}, #{operator}, #{operator}, #{operator}, #{line.locationId}, #{line.id}, 0, #{line.costPrice} FROM ph_inv_stocktake t WHERE t.id = #{line.stocktakeId} AND t.tenant_id = #{scope.tenantId}
